43 weeks = 43 × 7 = 301 days.  
Add 6 days → total extra days = 307 days.  
1894 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
From 1894-04-10 add 307 days:  
April: 20 days left (30 total, 10 gone) → 20 days.  
May: 31 → 51 total.  
June: 30 → 81 total.  
July: 31 → 112 total.  
August: 31 → 143 total.  
September: 30 → 173 total.  
October: 31 → 204 total.  
November: 30 → 234 total.  
December: 31 → 265 total.  
Remaining days = 307 − 265 = 42 days into 1895.  
January 1895: 31 days → 11 days left into February.  
February 1895 (not leap year): 11 days → date = 1895-02-11.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1895-02-11
